newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Moderate tremor jars northern Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Moderate tremor jars northern Philippines.

text.p: A moderately strong earthquake rocked the northern Philippine region early on Thursday, but there were no reports of casualty or damage, seismologists said.

The government's seismology office said the tremor had a magnitude of 5.5 on the Richter Scale and was centred in the sea more than 60 miles northwest of the northern city of Vigan in Ilocos Sur province.

"It was relatively strong but the epicentre was away from populated areas and we don't expect any casualties or major damage," a spokesman for the Philippine Volcanology and Seismology Commission said.
